title: What do they usually do?
description: Listen and answer questions about routines; practise the simple present, time expressions and everyday activities. 听录音并回答有关日常活动的问题；练习一般现在时、时间表达和日常活动。
answer_note: Textbook written exercises and grammar questions about the learner have no supplied official answers; model answers are labelled suggested. Workbook A answers 2-4 and workbook B answers 1-6 follow the supplied Lesson 56 key; B is described by the key as open-ended, with possible answers. Grammar exercise I answers follow the supplied grammar key. The 31st-34th picture vocabulary entries are confirmed from the supplementary textbook PDF because the supplied lesson photograph crops the lower edge. No audio transcript or listening answer key was supplied.

lesson.text: Lesson 56  What do they usually do?  他们通常做什么？
Time expressions: every day; in the morning; in the afternoon; in the evening; at noon; at night.
1st: dusts. Picture cue: a woman dusts a cupboard.
2nd: makes. Picture cue: a person makes the bed.
3rd: shaves. Picture cue: a person shaving.
4th: listen. Picture cue: a family sits together listening to a radio or stereo.
21st: cleans. Picture cue: a person cleans a blackboard.
22nd: go. Picture cue: two children are shown in separate beds.
23rd: washes. Picture cue: a woman washes dishes by hand.
24th: type. Picture cue: two people each sit at a typewriter.
31st: drinks. Picture cue: a cat drinks from a dish.
32nd: watch. Picture cue: a family watches television.
33rd: eats. Picture cue: a person eats at a table beside a clock.
34th: reads. Picture cue: a person sits in an armchair reading a newspaper.

lesson.title: Written exercises A
lesson.instruction: Complete these sentences using s or es.
lesson.translation: 完成以下句子，根据需要在动词后面加上 s 或 es。

questions.prompt: She wash ____ the dishes every day.
questions.answer: She washes the dishes every day.

questions.prompt: The children go ____ to school in the morning.
questions.answer: The children go to school in the morning.

questions.prompt: Their father take ____ them to school.
questions.answer: Their father takes them to school.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Sawyer stay ____ at home.
questions.answer: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home.

questions.prompt: She do ____ the housework.
questions.answer: She does the housework.

questions.prompt: She always eat ____ her lunch at noon.
questions.answer: She always eats her lunch at noon.

questions.prompt: she/morning; often/dust/the cupboard
questions.answer:
What does she do in the morning?
She often dusts the cupboard in the morning.

questions.prompt: she/morning; always/make/the bed
questions.answer:
What does she do in the morning?
She always makes the bed in the morning.

questions.prompt: he/morning; always/shave
questions.answer:
What does he do in the morning?
He always shaves in the morning.

questions.prompt: they/evening; sometimes/listen to/the stereo
questions.answer:
What do they do in the evening?
They sometimes listen to the stereo in the evening.

questions.prompt: he/every day; always/clean/the blackboard
questions.answer:
What does he do every day?
He always cleans the blackboard every day.

questions.prompt: they/night; always/go/to bed early
questions.answer:
What do they do at night?
They always go to bed early at night.

questions.prompt: she/every day; usually/wash/the dishes
questions.answer:
What does she do every day?
She usually washes the dishes every day.

questions.prompt: they/afternoon; usually/type/some letters
questions.answer:
What do they do in the afternoon?
They usually type some letters in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: it/every day; usually/drink/some milk
questions.answer:
What does it do every day?
It usually drinks some milk every day.

questions.prompt: they/evening; sometimes/watch/television
questions.answer:
What do they do in the evening?
They sometimes watch television in the evening.

questions.prompt: she/noon; always/eat/her lunch
questions.answer:
What does she do at noon?
She always eats her lunch at noon.

questions.prompt: he/evening; often/read/his newspaper
questions.answer:
What does he do in the evening?
He often reads his newspaper in the evening.

practice.title: A. What do they do? Questions and answers
practice.instruction: Look. Write questions and answers from these prompts.
practice.translation: 请看下表。根据提示写出疑问句并作出回答。
practice.context:
Table columns 1, 2, 3, 4:
She | [blank] | makes the beds | every day.
He | always | shaves | in the morning.
She | sometimes | goes to the village | in the afternoon.
It | usually | rains | in the evening.
They | often | watch television | at night.
I | always | eat my lunch | at noon.

questions.prompt:
When / she / make the beds?
every day
questions.answer:
When does she make the beds?
She makes the beds every day.

questions.prompt:
When / she / go to the village?
sometimes / in the afternoon
questions.answer:
When does she go to the village?
She sometimes goes to the village in the afternoon.

questions.prompt:
When / your father / shave?
always / in the morning
questions.answer:
When does your father shave?
He always shaves in the morning.

questions.prompt: When / your friends / watch television? / often / at night
questions.answer:
When do your friends watch television?
They often watch television at night.

practice.title: B. About you
practice.instruction: Answer these questions about yourself with complete sentences.
practice.translation: 根据你自己的情况用完整的英文句子回答以下问题。
practice.context: The supplied answer key labels this section open-ended and provides possible answers.

questions.prompt: When do you go to school?
questions.answer: I go to school every day.

questions.prompt: When do you eat your lunch?
questions.answer: I always eat my lunch at noon.

questions.prompt: Do you usually eat lunch at home?
questions.answer: I don't usually eat lunch at home.

questions.prompt: When do you come home from school?
questions.answer: I come home from school late in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: Do you always go to bed early?
questions.answer: No, I always go to bed late.

questions.prompt: When do you do your homework?
questions.answer: I (usually) do my homework in the evening.

grammar.title: I. Fill in each blank with the correct form of the verb given.
grammar.instruction: Fill in each blank with the correct form of the verb given.
grammar.translation: 用所给动词的正确形式填空。
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=487
grammar.context: Each numbered sentence is one response field; enter its missing verb forms in source order.

questions.prompt: John ____ (live) in a small city. He ____ (be) a student. He ____ (get) up early in the morning every day, at seven o'clock, and ____ (go) to school by bus. He ____ (like) English best. He ____ (play) football at school. He ____ (get) home at four o'clock in the afternoon. Then he ____ (do) his homework before dinner, and ____ (watch) television after dinner in the evening. He usually ____ (go) to bed at nine o'clock.
questions.answer:
lives
is
gets
goes
likes
plays
gets
does
watches
goes

questions.prompt: Mrs. Scott and her sister Emma ____ (be) teachers. They ____ (teach) in the same school. They ____ (go) to work by car. They ____ (leave) home at seven thirty in the morning, and ____ (come) back home at four in the afternoon. In the evening, they usually ____ (read) books, but sometimes they ____ (listen) to the stereo. They ____ (like) their jobs.
questions.answer:
are
teach
go
leave
come
read
listen
like

grammar.source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=172
grammar.title: II. Answer the questions about you.
grammar.translation: 根据你的情况回答下列问题。
grammar.context: Open personal-response questions. Suggested answers are examples only; answers depend on the learner.

questions.prompt: Where do you come from?
questions.answer: I come from China.

questions.prompt: Where do you live?
questions.answer: I live in China.

questions.prompt: What do you usually do in the morning?
questions.answer: I usually have breakfast in the morning.

questions.prompt: Who often cooks meals in your family?
questions.answer: My mother often cooks meals in my family.

questions.prompt: Do you often help your mother? What do you usually do?
questions.answer: Yes, I do. I usually help her with the housework.

questions.prompt: Who often makes the beds, cleans the rooms and washes the dishes?
questions.answer: My mother often makes the beds, cleans the rooms and washes the dishes.

questions.prompt: What do you usually eat for lunch?
questions.answer: I usually eat rice and vegetables for lunch.

questions.prompt: What do you often do in the afternoon? What about in the evening?
questions.answer: I often study in the afternoon. In the evening, I usually do my homework.

questions.prompt: Do you speak and listen to English every day?
questions.answer: Yes, I do. I speak and listen to English every day.

questions.prompt: Which season(s) do you like best?
questions.answer: I like spring best.
